facts.fact: Brian 昏迷在沙发上——威士忌杯底白色颗粒残渣：被下药。
facts.anchor: the faintest hint of white residue in the bottom, granulated.

facts.fact: Dawes 颈动脉被刀割开——手笨拙垫在脸下像在按压伤口；无线电被夺、枪套空了。
facts.anchor: his throat opened roughly with a knife, slashed across one side, right through the carotid

facts.fact: 凶手没等他死——一击、解除武装、夺无线电、放血；动作要快因为声响会引人。
facts.anchor: They hadn’t waited around for him to die. A sharp blow to the neck. Disarmed. Relieved of his radio.

facts.fact: 同一凶手：与 Rebecca 案相同的完美执行感。
facts.anchor: It had the same feel of perfect execution.

facts.fact: 下药预谋：得知道他喝哪个瓶、今晚会不会喝——也许每晚都喝，也许每个瓶都下了药。
facts.anchor: Would have had to know that he would do that tonight—perhaps would have to know that he did that every night

facts.fact: 孩子房间门被带子互相拉紧锁死——不在乎孩子、但不想被打断。
facts.anchor: The killer had no concern for the children but didn’t want to be interrupted either.

facts.fact: April 被扎带 hog-tied、昏迷——和 Rebecca 一样被下药。
facts.anchor: Drugged as well, Alex thought, just like Rebecca Cook had been.

facts.fact: 凶手全身黑装（cargo 裤、丁腈手套、巴拉克拉法帽）——夜里的影子，邻居醒着也看不见。
facts.anchor: clad in black from head to toe

facts.fact: 凶手假意服从，用脚跟钩住地毯 runner 猛拽——掀翻 Alex；她枪走火上天花板。
facts.anchor: he simply drove his right heel backward, his left now free of the runner carpet

facts.fact: 肩撞墙、枪被击落、腹部三四记重拳、揪发、肘击——她眼前只剩黑暗。
facts.anchor: two, three, four heavy body shots reverberated through her stomach and ribs
